title: Milestone epoch and gradual freeze policy for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Objective: Define a pragmatic milestone cadence ("epoch") and a staged code/content freeze policy that reduces last-minute scope churn across API, Console, and Runtime teams while preserving flexibility for critical fixes and security patches. This ticket owns the decision heuristics (when to move from soft to hard freeze), the scoped exceptions process, the release note handoff templates, and the cross-team signoff checklist needed for the next coordinated ship window.

Background: Recent synchronized releases exposed friction where teams applied different interpretations of 'scope freeze' and late product changes increased QA and release risk. We need a concrete, time-based policy and lightweight gating to make milestone decisions deterministic and auditable.

Outcomes: 1) A shared milestone calendar with epoch boundaries and owners; 2) A 2-stage freeze policy (soft, then hard) with example allowed exceptions and approval flow; 3) Release notes synchronization template and a dedicated slack cadence for signoff; 4) A short runbook for handling last-minute regressions and rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone epoch calendar published and accepted by API / Console / Runtime leads
Freeze policy doc with explicit time windows, allowed-exceptions, and approver list is published in Confluence
Release notes coordination template created and tested with one internal dry-run
Stakeholders (engineering leads, QA, SRE, docs, solutions) have approved signoff criteria recorded as comments in the doc
Rollout decision matrix (go/no-go) added to release runbook and verified with staging deployment test

cut_rules: Soft freeze: Begins 7 calendar days before epoch boundary. No new non-critical features may be merged to main; bugfixes must cite a test case and owner.
Hard freeze: Begins 48 hours before the ship decision point. Only P0/P1 regressions and security fixes allowed. All exceptions require documented approval from two approvers (ENG lead + PM).
Feature gate: Any feature missing completed release notes or API contract review is automatically deferred to next epoch unless two approvers sign off with documented risk mitigation.
Blocker rollback trigger: If blocking SLO regressions are observed in staging for >30 minutes after a candidate deploy, revert and pause the epoch decision until investigation completes.

Security override: Critical security or compliance issues can bypass the freeze with emergency signoff from Security and SRE; communicate via the on-call incident channel and update release notes with mitigation steps.
communication_plan: Channels: #release-window (Slack) for day-to-day coordination, dedicated weekly 30m sync in Calendar: 'Epoch Planning', and RFC updates in Confluence. Templates: release-notes-handoff.md (docs -> PM -> ENG), signoff checklist (checkbox list embedded in Confluence), and a PR comment template that reminds engineers to attach test artifacts and API diff. Stakeholder cadence: weekly syncs until soft freeze, daily 15m standups during the 48-hour hard freeze. Pre-shift comms: Publish 'Ship readiness snapshot' 24 hours before decision (links: dashboard token-latency, error-rate, integration-tests).
